finding: Grade 0 is much more common than severe grades. Use class-aware methods during model development.
EyePACS is substantially larger than the other datasets.
Original image sizes differ across datasets; the processed 224×224 images provide a consistent input.
MESSIDOR-2 has official gradability labels. Other datasets have missing official quality labels.
IDRiD has lesion masks; the other current datasets do not provide lesion masks.
